working_on.feature: Landscape UI Optimization for Carlinkit TBox Android Box
working_on.task: Completed 3 full phases: StationNameSanitizer & Marquee (Phase 01), Fullscreen Immersive & 58dp Navigation Rail (Phase 02), Dedicated Landscape Screens (Phase 03). All unit tests passing, pushed to GitHub main.
working_on.notes: Code tested, committed, and pushed to https://github.com/skul9x/EV-Plus.git main (commit 2e45142).

recent_changes.description: Landscape Carlinkit TBox UI Optimization: StationNameSanitizer + Marquee titles, Fullscreen Immersive Sticky mode, 58dp compact navigation rail, dedicated NearbyLandscapeScreen & FavoritesLandscapeScreen with 0 TopAppBar and reclaimed 95dp vertical space.
Focus Mode Header Marquee, distance badge removal, and strict VinFast station search filtering (isVinFast).

Unresolved reference AppIcons.Warning during FavoritesLandscapeScreen compilation
errors_encountered.solution: Replaced with AppIcons.Error which is registered in AppIcons registry

decisions_made.decision: Separate dedicated landscape screens (NearbyLandscapeScreen & FavoritesLandscapeScreen) instead of nested conditionals inside portrait screens
decisions_made.reason: Completely decouples automotive in-car rendering, enforces 0 nested if (!isLandscape) branches, and eliminates 95dp overhead from TopAppBar and summary pill

decisions_made.decision: Use 58dp navigation rail with 50dp touch targets and 26dp icons
decisions_made.reason: Reclaims 14dp horizontal width compared to default 72dp rail while maintaining compliant automotive touch safety

decisions_made.decision: Use StationNameSanitizer to strip redundant 'Trạm sạc VinFast' prefixes and enable horizontal marquee on station cards
decisions_made.reason: Allows station cards in 360-400dp columns to show actual distinctive location names immediately at a glance
